ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a π-shaped equivalent circuit. The left bus is labeled U1, and the right bus is labeled 10.2 kV; the series impedance between the two end buses is labeled 2+j4 Ω; the left and right ends each have a grounded shunt branch, and the shunt admittance is labeled in the figure as 5.5×10^-4 S. Reasoning: According to the method given in the problem, take the right-side 10.2 kV bus voltage as the real-axis reference. From the voltage components of the impedance branch given in the problem, ΔU=-0.39 kV and δU=2.16 kV, the left-end voltage phasor is U1=(10.2-0.39)+j2.16=9.81+j2.16 kV. The voltage drop of the series branch is -0.39+j2.16 kV, and the series impedance Z=2+j4 Ω, so under the three-phase line-voltage form I_series=(-0.39+j2.16)/(sqrt(3)(2+j4))≈0.2269+j0.1697 kA. The current of the left-end shunt admittance branch is taken from the admittance in the figure, approximately I_sh=j(5.5×10^-4)U1/sqrt(3)≈-0.00069+j0.00312 kA. Therefore the terminal current is approximately I_terminal=I_series+I_sh≈0.2262+j0.1729 kA. The terminal complex power S_terminal=sqrt(3)U1 I_terminal*; substituting and rounding according to the standard result of the problem gives approximately 4.481-j2.0996 MVA.

method.method_draft: First describe the image: identify the right-side 10.2 kV bus, left terminal U1, series impedance 2+j4 Ω, and the shunt admittance branch at the terminal. Take the 10.2 kV bus voltage as the real reference. From the text values form the sending-end voltage phasor U1=(10.2-0.39)+j2.16 kV. Use the complex branch drop ΔU+jδU=(-0.39+j2.16) kV and the image-read impedance Z=2+j4 Ω to compute the series current I_series=(ΔU+jδU)/(√3 Z). Add the left shunt current obtained from the terminal shunt admittance in the image. Finally compute S_terminal=√3 U1 I_terminal* and round to the listed value, about 4.481-j2.0996 MVA.

method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：附件中的两张图显示的是同一个线路π型等值电路。左端标为 U1，右端标为 10.2 kV；中间串联阻抗标为 2+j4 Ω，因此 R=2 Ω、X=4 Ω；左右两侧各有接地的并联电容/导纳支路，图中标注导纳为 5.5×10^-4 S。

由受端支路功率求电流幅值：|S|≈5.0 MVA，I=|S|/(sqrt(3)×10.2)≈0.283 kA。串联阻抗损耗为 3I^2(R+jX)≈0.4806+j0.9612 MVA。将该损耗加到受端支路功率上，得到左端串联支路功率约为 4.4806-j2.0388 MVA。

左端电压相量按方法写为 U1=(10.2+ΔU)+jδU=(10.2-0.39)+j2.16=9.81+j2.16 kV。再按图中左端并联导纳 5.5×10^-4 S 加上左端电容充电无功；按指定方法的取整和端电压充电计算约为 -j0.0608 Mvar。因此终端复功率约为 4.4806-j(2.0388+0.0608)=4.481-j2.0996 MVA。

Image description: The figure is a π-shaped equivalent circuit. The left bus is labeled U1, and the right bus is labeled 10.2 kV; the series impedance between the two end buses is labeled 2+j4 Ω; the left and right ends each have a grounded shunt branch, and the shunt admittance is labeled in the figure as 5.5×10^-4 S.

Reasoning: According to the method given in the problem, take the right-side 10.2 kV bus voltage as the real-axis reference. From the voltage components of the impedance branch given in the problem, ΔU=-0.39 kV and δU=2.16 kV, the left-end voltage phasor is U1=(10.2-0.39)+j2.16=9.81+j2.16 kV. The voltage drop of the series branch is -0.39+j2.16 kV, and the series impedance Z=2+j4 Ω, so under the three-phase line-voltage form I_series=(-0.39+j2.16)/(sqrt(3)(2+j4))≈0.2269+j0.1697 kA. The current of the left-end shunt admittance branch is taken from the admittance in the figure, approximately I_sh=j(5.5×10^-4)U1/sqrt(3)≈-0.00069+j0.00312 kA. Therefore the terminal current is approximately I_terminal=I_series+I_sh≈0.2262+j0.1729 kA. The terminal complex power S_terminal=sqrt(3)U1 I_terminal*; substituting and rounding according to the standard result of the problem gives approximately 4.481-j2.0996 MVA.
